verdict.rationale: Cline can pull third-party capabilities into its workflows. MCP servers let it use external tools and data sources (cline-docs-16), the native app manages plugins and MCP servers (cline-gh-2, cline-gh-3), and it plugs into Slack, Discord, Linear and CI pipelines (cline-docs-17). None of this is framed as integrating partner-built agent apps; these are tool connectors and plugins rather than a partner agent ecosystem. Missing for 10: a documented partner or third-party agent app marketplace or catalog, a mechanism for orchestrating externally built agents inside Cline workflows, and independent corroboration of partner integrations.
